use_cases.title: Show and hide the layer switcher via the toolbar button
use_cases.description: The user toggles the layer switcher (TOC) panel off and on using the toolbar button.
preconditions: The layer switcher (TOC) is initially visible.
steps: The user clicks the 'Layer Switcher' button in the toolbar to hide the panel.
The user clicks the 'Layer Switcher' button again to show the panel.
expected_result: After the first click, the layer switcher panel is no longer visible.
After the second click, the layer switcher panel is visible again.

use_cases.title: Switch the base map from Carto Light to OpenStreetMap
use_cases.description: The user changes the active base map in the layer switcher.
preconditions: The Carto Light base map is active by default.
steps: The user opens the base map selector in the layer switcher.
The user selects 'OpenStreetMap' as the base map.
expected_result: The OpenStreetMap base map is selected.
The Carto Light base map is no longer selected.

use_cases.title: Zoom in and out using the zoom buttons
use_cases.description: The user changes the map zoom level using the zoom in and zoom out buttons.
preconditions: The zoom in and zoom out buttons are visible on the map.
steps: The user clicks the 'Zoom in' button to increase the zoom level.
The user clicks the 'Zoom out' button to decrease the zoom level.
expected_result: After clicking the 'Zoom in' button, the map zoom level is higher than before.
After clicking the 'Zoom out' button, the map zoom level is lower than after zooming in.

use_cases.title: Activate the UV-Index overlay and verify it is rendered on the map
use_cases.description: The user activates the initially hidden UV-Index overlay and verifies that the layer is requested and rendered on the map.
preconditions: The UV-Index overlay layer is initially hidden.
steps: The user clicks the visibility toggle of the UV-Index overlay layer to show it.
The user waits for the map to load the layer tiles.
expected_result: The UV-Index overlay layer toggle is in the enabled (checked) state.
The UV-Index overlay tiles are rendered on the map canvas.

use_cases.title: Activate the Precipitation overlay and verify the legend updates
use_cases.description: The user activates the Precipitation overlay and checks that the legend reflects the newly active layer.
preconditions: The layer switcher (TOC) and legend are visible.
The Precipitation overlay layer is initially hidden.
steps: The user clicks the visibility toggle of the Precipitation overlay layer to show it.
The user views the legend.
expected_result: The Precipitation overlay layer toggle is in the enabled (checked) state.
The legend displays an entry corresponding to the Precipitation layer.

use_cases.title: Click an map position to show the weather forecast
use_cases.description: The user clicks an position on the map and checks that the weather forecast appears in the info panel.
steps: The user clicks on a position on the map canvas.
The user waits for the info panel to load the forecast.
expected_result: The clicked position is highlighted on the map.
The info panel displays a weather forecast section.
The forecast contains 24 entries.

use_cases.title: Click a UVI station to show feature info
use_cases.description: The user clicks on a UVI station marker and checks that the WMS GetFeatureInfo result appears in the info panel.
preconditions: The UV-Index Stations layer is active (visible by default).
The map is positioned so at least one UVI station is visible.
steps: The user clicks on a UVI station marker on the map canvas.
The user waits for the info panel to load the station info.
expected_result: A WMS GetFeatureInfo request for the UV-Index Stations layer is sent to the DWD geoserver.
The info panel displays a 'UV-Index Station' section with feature information from the GetFeatureInfo response.

use_cases.title: Measure a distance by drawing a line on the map
use_cases.description: The user activates the measurement tool, draws a line on the map and checks that a measurement result is shown.
preconditions: The measurement tool is accessible via the toolbar.
steps: The user clicks the 'Measurement' button in the toolbar to open the measurement panel.
The user clicks several points on the map canvas to draw a line.
The user double-clicks to finish the measurement.
expected_result: The measurement panel is visible.
The measurement panel displays a length value with a unit.

use_cases.title: Print the current map view as a PNG
use_cases.description: The user opens the printing panel, enters a title, selects the PNG format and triggers the export of the current map view.
preconditions: The printing tool is accessible via the toolbar.
At least one base map and one overlay layer are visible on the map.
steps: The user clicks the 'Print Map' button in the toolbar to open the printing panel.
The user enters a title for the printout.
The user selects the PNG file format.
The user clicks the export/print button.
expected_result: The printing panel is visible.
A PNG file containing the current map view is generated and downloaded.
The printed image shows the visible base map and overlay layers as well as the scale bar.

use_cases.title: Configure layers, search for a location and load the weather forecast
use_cases.description: The user reconfigures the layer visibility, searches for a location using the geocoder, navigates the map to the selected result, and load the weather forecast for that position.
preconditions: The Temperature overlay layer is initially visible.
The Precipitation overlay layer is initially hidden.
steps: The user clicks the visibility toggle of the Temperature overlay layer to hide it.
The user clicks the visibility toggle of the Precipitation overlay layer to show it.
The user clicks the search field and types a place name (e.g. 'Münster').
The user waits for the result list to appear and selects the first result.
The user waits for the map to navigate to the selected location.
The user waits for the info panel to load the forecast.
expected_result: The Precipitation overlay layer toggle is in the disabled state.
The Temperature overlay layer toggle is in the enabled state.
After selecting the search result, the map navigates to the searched location.
The info panel displays a weather forecast section with 24 entries.
